world_seed.visual_direction: Storm-gray canvas, celadon instruments, electric-yellow silk, wet charcoal floors

genre: meteorological night market, climate craft, delivery disputes
premise: Vendors sell unfinished meteorological phenomena before they are released into the planetary sky.
simulation_objective: Facilitate the trade and stabilization of volatile weather assets while managing local atmospheric interference.
economy_focus: Atmospheric futures and raw climate components
exploration_focus: Navigating shifting visibility and micro-climates within the market stalls
visual_style: High-contrast pixel art with silver condensation effects and electric-yellow accents

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Characters wear heavy, waterproof storm-gray canvas with bright electric-yellow silk accents for visibility and magenta thread for certification.
